Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Detroit hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 18 Detroit hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 4, Super.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Agoda at 1, Expedia.de at 1, Luxury Escapes at 1 and Wego at 1. These are the Detroit rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 3, Super.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Agoda at 1, Expedia.de at 1, Luxury Escapes at 1 and Wego at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 7, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Detroit hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($11 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 8% at Quality Inn Detroit Downtown to 16% at MGM Grand Detroit. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
